description: Create an order for a plan and return a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open and pay. The price is the local price for the country this request comes from and is shown in the result. After the user pays, use check_order_status to confirm. Product ids come from list_plans. Uses the user's minutes or credits or creates a payment; tell the user what it costs and get their agreement first. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope account:write.)

deferActivation.description: Passes only: true = keep the pass unactivated after payment until the user activates it (activate_subscription_card)

name: create_payment_order
